context_selection: 300 m by default around selected road network bounding rectangle, including whole ways
limitations: Whole ways intersecting the requested bbox are retained; the graph omits neighboring ways outside the window, so valid detours may be unavailable. Enlarge the bbox if routing fails.
Building/tree/place context uses a buffer around the full selected network extent; it is not a bound on route detour distance.
The road graph is undirected, matching the existing engine; foot-direction rules, timed/conditional restrictions, turn restrictions, closures and ferry schedules are not implemented.

Waterfront polygons/access points are auxiliary context; access-point coverage is incomplete and does not imply that every publicly owned waterfront is publicly accessible. Citywide access points are retained, but only those within the engine's 150 m network snapping limit affect distances.
Official building placeholder triangles (FEATURE_CODE 1003) are excluded from openness measurement; other official footprint categories remain included.
This window adapter is a local data-usability demo, not a citywide live routing deployment or a scientific validation of astrology-derived weights.
The Python engine has not been checked for complete output equivalence against a live Rhino/Grasshopper execution.
Include status=Alive in the 2015 census only. This does not assert survival today, canopy size, shade, or park-tree completeness.

Saved OSM scores plus conservative DOHMH additions, excluding high-confidence existing identity matches with a latest official closure action pending review. Source archives remain intact. Crossmatched identities are not double-counted. Ambiguous, closed, restricted or insufficiently documented additions remain review candidates. No inspection grade is used as experience quality.
Source record checks do not verify present conditions or experienced quality; no field feedback has trained these scores.

open.measurement: 8-ray horizontal distance to official building boundaries, capped at 200 m
sources: NYC OTI Building Footprints; snapshot retrieved 2026-10-13
limitations: Measured from mapped geometry, not field-rated openness; no sky view or building-height model.

green.measurement: Count of records classified Alive in the 2015 Street Tree Census within 50 m
sources: NYC DPR 2015 Street Tree Census; Alive only
limitations: Historical alive status, not current survival, canopy, shade, or all park trees.
No measured sound, crowd levels, construction or time-of-day observations.

social.measurement: Sum of category-based social components within 100 m
sources: NYC DOHMH administrative records retrieved 2026-10-13; per-record inspection dates vary
limitations: Only food venue records are crosschecked. No measured social atmosphere or current occupancy.
An unmatched official record is not proof that no OSM duplicate exists.

access.measurement: Sum of category-based amenity components within 100 m
sources: NYC DOHMH administrative records retrieved 2026-10-13; per-record inspection dates vary
limitations: Amenity proximity, not wheelchair access, verified entrances, or live opening hours.
Only the food venue subset has an additional official source.
